errors.evidence: The data for adolescents and young adults (light blue line) is completely misreported. In 2012, the value is about 7.3 (not 6.8). In 2023, it is about 7.4 (not 6.3), and in 2024, it is about 7.6 (not 6.6).

The line representing seniors is purple (lilac), not red (rot).

errors.evidence: The entire numerical description for the seniors line is incorrect and appears to be confused with the data from the adolescents' line. The seniors' line starts at ~6.9 in 2012, remains below 7.0 until 2019, and ends at ~6.85 in 2024. The reported values (7.4, 7.2, 7.3, 7.6) are completely wrong for this group.
